# Benoît Hervier, Freelance Lead Developer & Software Architect

> Benoît Hervier is a freelance lead developer and software architect based near Paris, France, with 20+ years of experience in Go (Golang), Python and C/C++ on Linux. He designs and builds reliable systems: 24/7 broadcast capture and AI media analytics platforms (speech-to-text, OCR, LLM enrichment, audio fingerprinting, vector search), CE-certified Class IIa embedded medical devices, scalable backend services and SaaS. Currently available part-time for freelance missions, consulting and audits. Contact: b@rvier.fr or Malt (https://www.malt.fr/profile/benoithervier).

En français : Benoît Hervier est développeur Go et Python freelance, lead developer et architecte logiciel indépendant, basé à Crépy-en-Valois (Oise), au nord-est de Paris, avec plus de 20 ans d'expérience. Spécialités : plateformes de captation broadcast 24/7 (TV, radio, TNT, DVB, FFmpeg), IA appliquée aux médias (transcription Whisper, OCR, enrichissement par LLM auto-hébergés, recherche vectorielle pgvector), firmware embarqué et dispositifs médicaux certifiés CE classe IIa, services backend et SaaS en Go. Disponible à temps partiel pour des missions en régie ou au forfait, du conseil, des audits ou la reprise de projets en difficulté, en télétravail ou sur site en Île-de-France. TJM indicatif : 600 à 750 € HT selon la mission. Contact : b@rvier.fr ou Malt.

Key facts:

- Name: Benoît Hervier
- Role: Freelance Lead Developer & Software Architect
- Experience: 20+ years
- Location: Crépy-en-Valois (Oise, Hauts-de-France), about 60 km north-east of Paris
- Work mode: remote across France, on-site possible in Paris and Île-de-France
- Availability: part-time, a few days per week alongside an ongoing engagement
- Engagements: time and materials (régie) or fixed price (forfait), consulting, audits
- Daily rate: 600 to 750 EUR excl. VAT, depending on the mission
- French company number (SIRET): 520 039 132 00037
- Languages: French (native), English (professional)
- Core stack: Go, Python, C, C++, Embedded Linux, PostgreSQL, FFmpeg
- Domains: broadcast and media monitoring, applied AI (Whisper, OCR, LLM pipelines, pgvector), embedded firmware and BLE medical devices, real-time and distributed systems
- Industries: media and broadcast, medtech, defense (DGA), mining and explosives, finance, real estate
- Email: b@rvier.fr
- Malt: https://www.malt.fr/profile/benoithervier
- Website: https://rvier.fr/
- GitHub: https://github.com/brvier
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/benoithervier/

Services:

- Software architecture and technical leadership for backend, media and AI platforms
- Go and Python services: APIs, workers, orchestrators, distributed systems
- Applied AI integration: speech-to-text at scale (Whisper, diarization), OCR fine-tuning, self-hosted LLM pipelines, vector search (pgvector)
- Audio and video pipelines: FFmpeg, broadcast capture (TNT, DVB, radio, web streams), hardware decoding
- Embedded Linux and firmware development (nRF52, BLE), including regulated medical devices (CE Class IIa)
- SaaS development in Go with Templ and HTMX, without a JavaScript framework
- Setting up AI coding agents for a team: AGENTS.md files, skills, house conventions
- Audits, rescue missions and performance optimization of existing systems
